Class RuntimeInputs

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.RuntimeInputs
All Implemented Interfaces:
LoggableInputs
public final class RuntimeInputs extends Object implements LoggableInputs
Facts about where the code is running that logic depends on, as an AdvantageKit input.

Replay always runs in Constants.Mode.REPLAY, so code that branches on "is this the simulator?" would take the simulator's branch when replaying a real match. Anything that must behave the way the recorded run did reads this instead: on the robot and in the sim it records the truth; in replay it restores what the recorded run was.
